performance.verdict: Meta dark for 15 days; contract gap is the real blocker, not ad performance.

findings.text: Spend has been $0 every day since Aug 6 — 15 consecutive zero-spend days; all 39 leads came from the prior 13 days of the 28-day window.
3-day signal (Aug 18–20): spend $0, leads 0, vs prior 3 days (Aug 15–17) also $0 — the account has been fully dark for 2+ weeks, not a temporary dip.
GHL shows 31 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in the 28-day window — intake pipeline is not converting even the leads that did arrive.
GBP actions dropped 90.74% week-over-week; the last 3 days in series show 0 GBP actions, erasing the organic safety net while paid is also dark.
When Meta was live (Jul 24 – Aug 5), CPL averaged $24.44 over 28 days — within the $19–45 historical weekly range, so efficiency was not the reason spend stopped.

suggestions.text: Resolve contract/billing blocker immediately; reactivate Meta spend at prior $65–75/day — 15 days of zero spend is confirmed revenue stoppage.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been at $0 spend for 15 consecutive days (Aug 6–20), costing an estimated 30–45 leads at the account's $24.44 CPL. The blocker is the open contract extension with Marwan, not ad performance — CPL was healthy at $24.44 when ads ran. Success check: Meta spend back at $65–75/day with leads resuming by Aug 25. Sohib to confirm contract status before reactivation.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 31 contacts, 0 opportunities created — confirm Andrew's intake process is converting contacts to opps before new leads arrive.
suggestions.monday_update: The GHL pipeline shows 31 contacts and 0 opportunities created with 0 appointments in the 28-day window — leads are arriving but not advancing, which is an intake problem, not an ads problem. Before Meta is reactivated, Andrew should confirm the contact-to-opportunity workflow is functioning in Zoho/GHL. Success check: at least 1 opportunity created per 3 new contacts within 7 days of ad reactivation. Flag to Nacer (Ops) if the workflow is broken.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP recovery after 90.74% drop; if actions remain near 0 by Aug 25, escalate listing audit — organic is the only active channel right now.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 90.74% week-over-week and the last 3 series days show 0 actions, eliminating organic lead support while Meta is dark. No paid channel is running to compensate. Re-check GBP actions on Aug 25; if still near zero, initiate a listing health audit (suspension check, review flag, algorithm change). Success check: GBP actions return to the prior 7-day baseline of ~6–13/day.
